title: Rehome shard orchestration into a pluggable activation shim and simplify tokenizer handshake
creator: Diego Morales
description: This ticket refactors the model loading pipeline to move shard orchestration responsibilities out of the legacy bootstrapper and into a small, pluggable 'activation shim'. The shim provides: (1) on-demand shard activation (lazy materialization) with a unified activation API, (2) a manifest translator to normalize diverse checkpoint formats, and (3) a simplified tokenizer handshake that replaces the vocab-bridge stateful path with an ephemeral lexicon mapper. Goals: reduce model load tail latency, simplify upgrade paths for new checkpoint formats, and make tokenizer init idempotent and testable.
steps: Add activation-shim interface and adapter registry in ingest/activation
Implement manifest-translator that outputs canonical manifest schema v2
Replace legacy shard-coordinator calls in bootstrapper with shim adapter calls
Introduce lazy-mmap-backed shard handle and async activation futures
Refactor tokenizer init to use ephemeral lexicon mapper and remove global vocab-bridge state
Add compatibility adapters for old formats: legacy-ckpt-v1, hybrid-shard, split-index
Add unit and integration tests for shim, translator, and tokenizer handshake
Run end-to-end perf runs and iterate on kernel selection knobs where load changes exposure
decisions: Keep activation-shim small: does NOT own weight decoding. Shim orchestrates activation only; decoder plugins remain separate.
Canonical manifest schema v2 chosen (fields: shards[], checksum, quant_meta, layout_hint) — easier to validate and smaller than proposed v3.
Tokenzier handshake will use ephemeral lexicon mapping and per-client cache keys; global mutable vocabulary state will be removed to avoid cross-request leaks.
Backward compatibility provided via adapters rather than inlining legacy code; adapters live under ingest/adapters to minimize heap pressure.
Security: shim exposes no network surface; KMS/HSM interactions remain in the existing secure loader path.
Rollout plan: feature-flag activation-shim behind runtime-1.21 toggle for gradual rollout across dedicated pools.
